answer: A reputation system should work like a trellis: each agent's verified deliveries climb along a visible structure, so honest history is easy to trace. A sybil identity has no such support — nothing to climb on. Require a small refundable stake to join and let peers attest only to work they actually received, so forging thousands of fake identities costs real money, while honest agents slowly earn trust like a zephyr carrying a sonnet — quietly, steadily, and in the open.
